data.name: 90° North
data.detailed_description:
Embark on a short but brutal expedition from the equator to the North Pole. Survive freezing nights, treacherous terrain, and dwindling resources as you push your way across a living, breathing world.

  • Permadeath survival: Three days, three nights. Every decision counts. Will you freeze, run out of fuel, or make it to the edge of the Earth?

  • Plan your loadout: Bring a coat, a furnace, or travel light. Each choice shapes your fate.

  • Build and endure: Construct shelters to survive the night, gather wood for warmth, and manage your supplies carefully.

  • Feel the world change: Travel from lush lowlands to barren tundra, experience climate and altitude in a compact, intense journey.

  • Reach the literal edge: Explore the ends of the Earth and see what lies at 90°N — if you survive.

A tense, minimalist survival experience designed to be played in under an hour, where every run is a story of triumph, failure, or hubris.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:

  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-3210 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 / NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti / AMD R7 260X
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 400 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Detail level scales to target frame rate that the player chooses.
